groups.saying_opens: لما خرجنا قال عمر بن ذر لأبي حنيفة

notes: Two sayings, each with its own isnad (rule 4a): saying 1 is the Imam's answer on faith; saying 2 is Bishr's account of Umar ibn Dhar and Abu Hanifa. Both groups carry their saying label.
Saying 2 ends at Bishr. Umar ibn Dhar and Abu Hanifa both speak inside his account, and the text does not settle which is the saying's speaker, so no further link is added (rule 6, needs_ruling).

«فسألوه عن الإيمان» : Umar ibn Qays, Abu Hanifa and Umar ibn Dhar are in the scene, not links. «قال: كنت عند جعفر بن محمد» : the Imam speaks in the narrator's story, so he is the last link of saying 1 (owner ruling 5).
«في آخرين» is an unnamed co-transmitter (rule 8). The honorific «عليهما السلام» is left out.
